There are two groups of dragon lairs located in the Kha'zeel mountain range:

  • Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs/Kha'labal (implemented in Updates/7.3 and accessible from the Kha'labal);
  • Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs/Tiquanda (implemented in Updates/10.8 and accessible from Tiquanda).
